error_message: npm ERR! Error: EACCES: permission denied, access '/usr/local/lib/node_modules'
context: I ran npm install -g typescript and got this error.

ground_truth.root_cause: npm tries to write to a directory owned by root
ground_truth.correct_fix: change npm prefix to user directory or use nvm
ground_truth.anti_pattern: do not use sudo npm install -g

error_message: FATAL ERROR: CALL_AND_RETRY_LAST Allocation failed - JavaScript heap out of memory
context: My Next.js build crashes with this error on CI.

ground_truth.root_cause: Node.js default memory limit exceeded during build
ground_truth.correct_fix: increase memory with --max-old-space-size
ground_truth.anti_pattern: do not just keep increasing memory without investigating the leak

error_message: error:0308010C:digital envelope routines::unsupported
context: After upgrading to Node 18 my webpack build fails with this.

ground_truth.root_cause: Node 17+ uses OpenSSL 3.0 which dropped support for some algorithms used by older webpack/tools
ground_truth.correct_fix: upgrade webpack and dependencies, or set NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider as temporary workaround
ground_truth.anti_pattern: do not permanently rely on --openssl-legacy-provider, upgrade your tools instead

error_message: exec format error
context: I built a Docker image on my M1 Mac and it fails when deployed to our x86 Linux servers.

ground_truth.root_cause: image built for ARM architecture cannot run on x86/amd64
ground_truth.correct_fix: build with --platform linux/amd64 or use docker buildx for multi-arch
ground_truth.anti_pattern: do not just rebuild without specifying platform

error_message: CrashLoopBackOff
context: My pod keeps restarting and shows CrashLoopBackOff status.

ground_truth.root_cause: container process exits with non-zero code, Kubernetes restarts with exponential backoff
ground_truth.correct_fix: check logs with kubectl logs --previous, check exit code with kubectl describe pod
ground_truth.anti_pattern: do not just delete the pod, deployment will recreate with same crash

error_message: OOMKilled
context: My Java app pod keeps getting OOMKilled after running for a few hours.

ground_truth.root_cause: container exceeded its memory limit, killed by the OOM killer
ground_truth.correct_fix: increase memory limits or fix memory leak, check with kubectl describe pod for last status
ground_truth.anti_pattern: do not just increase limits without investigating the leak

error_message: hint: You have divergent branches and need to specify how to reconcile them.
context: I tried git pull and got this error. Never seen it before.

ground_truth.root_cause: git 2.27+ requires explicit merge strategy when local and remote branches diverge
ground_truth.correct_fix: set pull strategy: git config pull.rebase false (merge) or git config pull.rebase true (rebase)
ground_truth.anti_pattern: do not just force push to resolve this

error_message: git@github.com: Permission denied (publickey). fatal: Could not read from remote repository.
context: I cloned a repo fine yesterday but now git push fails with this.

ground_truth.root_cause: SSH agent does not have your key loaded, or key not added to GitHub
ground_truth.correct_fix: run ssh-add, or check ~/.ssh/config, or add key to GitHub settings
ground_truth.anti_pattern: do not generate a new key without checking if existing one is loaded

error_message: error: externally-managed-environment
context: I ran pip install requests on my new Ubuntu 24.04 and got this error.

ground_truth.root_cause: PEP 668 prevents pip from modifying system Python packages to avoid breaking the OS
ground_truth.correct_fix: use a virtual environment (python -m venv) or pipx for CLI tools
ground_truth.anti_pattern: do not use --break-system-packages flag

error_message: Hydration failed because the initial UI does not match what was rendered on the server.
context: My Next.js page shows this error in the console. It only happens in production.

ground_truth.root_cause: server-rendered HTML differs from client-side render, usually due to browser-only APIs like window/localStorage or Date
ground_truth.correct_fix: use useEffect for browser-only code, ensure initial render matches server output
ground_truth.anti_pattern: do not add suppressHydrationWarning everywhere

error_message: Too many re-renders. React limits the number of renders to prevent an infinite loop.
context: I added a state update in my component and now it crashes with this.

ground_truth.root_cause: setState called during render causes infinite re-render loop
ground_truth.correct_fix: wrap state updates in event handlers or useEffect, do not call setState directly in component body
ground_truth.anti_pattern: do not call setState unconditionally in render

error_message: ERROR: relation "users" does not exist
context: I can see the table in pgAdmin but my app query fails with this error.

ground_truth.root_cause: wrong schema, wrong database, table name case sensitivity, or missing search_path
ground_truth.correct_fix: check current database and schema, use schema-qualified name, or set search_path
ground_truth.anti_pattern: do not create the table again without checking which database you are connected to

error_message: FATAL: too many connections for role "myapp"
context: My app works fine locally but in production during peak traffic I get this.

ground_truth.root_cause: app opens more connections than max_connections allows, usually missing connection pooling
ground_truth.correct_fix: use a connection pooler like PgBouncer, or configure pool size in your ORM
ground_truth.anti_pattern: do not just increase max_connections, each connection uses ~10MB RAM

error_message: no space left on device
context: Docker build fails with this but my disk still has 50GB free.

ground_truth.root_cause: Docker's storage area is full with old images, containers, and build cache, separate from host disk
ground_truth.correct_fix: run docker system prune to clean up unused resources
ground_truth.anti_pattern: do not just delete random files from the host filesystem

error_message: Type 'string | undefined' is not assignable to type 'string'. Type 'undefined' is not assignable to type 'string'.
context: I'm passing a value from an optional field to a function that requires a string.

ground_truth.root_cause: TypeScript strict null checks detect that the value could be undefined
ground_truth.correct_fix: add null check, use nullish coalescing (??), or non-null assertion (!) if certain
ground_truth.anti_pattern: do not disable strictNullChecks to fix this

error_message: 502 Bad Gateway
context: My nginx reverse proxy returns 502 when trying to reach my Node.js backend.

ground_truth.root_cause: nginx cannot connect to the upstream backend, either it is down, wrong port, or wrong address
ground_truth.correct_fix: check if backend is running, verify proxy_pass address and port, check nginx error log
ground_truth.anti_pattern: do not just restart nginx without checking if the backend is actually running

error_message: npm ERR! ERESOLVE unable to resolve dependency tree
context: I can't install dependencies after adding a new package.

ground_truth.root_cause: peer dependency conflict between packages requiring different versions
ground_truth.correct_fix: check which packages conflict, try --legacy-peer-deps, or update conflicting packages
ground_truth.anti_pattern: do not use --force as first resort, it can install incompatible versions

error_message: Too many open files
context: My Node.js server crashes with this after running for a day in production.

ground_truth.root_cause: process exceeded the file descriptor limit (ulimit), usually due to a file descriptor leak
ground_truth.correct_fix: increase ulimit and fix the leak, check with lsof or /proc/pid/fd
ground_truth.anti_pattern: do not just increase ulimit without investigating the leak

error_message: An error occurred (AccessDenied) when calling the PutObject operation: Access Denied
context: My Lambda function can't write to S3 even though I attached the S3 policy.

ground_truth.root_cause: IAM policy missing, wrong resource ARN, bucket policy blocking, or wrong execution role
ground_truth.correct_fix: check IAM policy resource ARN matches the bucket, check bucket policy, verify the Lambda execution role
ground_truth.anti_pattern: do not attach AdministratorAccess to fix this

error_message: borrow of moved value: `x`
context: I passed a String to a function and then tried to use it again.

ground_truth.root_cause: Rust ownership: passing a value to a function moves it, original variable is no longer valid
ground_truth.correct_fix: clone the value, pass a reference (&x), or restructure to avoid the move
ground_truth.anti_pattern: do not just clone everything, understand when to use references
